incident_text: De fortes inondations touchent un quartier résidentiel de Nabeul. Plusieurs routes sont bloquées et l'eau continue de monter.

result.scene_summary: A flooded town square with historic buildings partially submerged in brown water.

observations.description: Brown water covering the entire street and reaching up to the ground floors of buildings.
Multi-story buildings with storefronts at ground level, some with arched doorways and balconies.
Street signs including a red 'STOP' sign and a blue arrow sign visible on the right.
A street sign with 'AZ' visible on the facade of the central building.
A small white object floating on the water to the left.
